The University of Auckland, New Zealand
Gain an internationally recognised qualification through our world-class teaching and research facilities.
We are New Zealand’s leading university, ranked 67th* worldwide
We offer you the opportunity to gain an internationally-recognised qualification at one of the world’s top 100 universities*. Established in 1883, we are a research-led university, committed to quality and excellence in all our degree and diploma programmes.
We offer more than 30 undergraduate programmes from certificate to bachelor level across 125 different subjects. At postgraduate level we have over 130 programmes and provide more than 180 subjects to choose from.
